description: Find a canonical minimum vertex-disjoint path cover of a bounded directed acyclic graph.

source.title: Maximum Bipartite Matching — Minimum Path Cover in Directed Acyclic Graphs
source.author: OI Wiki contributors
source.primary_theorem: D. R. Fulkerson, Note on Dilworth's decomposition theorem for partially ordered sets, Proceedings of the AMS 7(4), 1956, DOI 10.1090/S0002-9939-1956-0078334-6.
source.reuse: Algorithm descriptions and theorem attribution only; contract, code, fixtures, and port implementations are clean-room.

input.graph: simple directed acyclic graph; no loops or repeated arcs

output.meaning: Canonical minimum path-cover count and one successor label per vertex.
output.encoding: (path_count << 40) | sum(successor[v] << (4*v)); successor[v]=N marks the end of a path. The canonical cover is the lexicographically smallest successor vector among maximum matchings, with neighbor IDs ordered ascending and the unmatched marker N considered last.
output.maximum_result_derivation: Conservative packed-field ceiling: (10 << 40) | (2^40 - 1), because path count is at most 10 and the successor field occupies 40 bits; actual successor nibbles are at most N<=10.

algorithm_profile.reduction: Create left and right copies of every DAG vertex and an edge u_left->v_right for each DAG arc u->v. A maximum matching of size K yields a vertex-disjoint path cover of size N-K.
algorithm_profile.primary: Deterministic Kuhn DFS augmenting paths compute matching cardinality. A feasibility pass fixes each successor in vertex order, choosing the smallest available target that preserves the maximum cardinality; this gives a canonical output cover.
algorithm_profile.independent: A suffix dynamic program over used right-vertex subsets computes the maximum matching extension and reconstructs the same lexicographically smallest successor vector.
algorithm_profile.tie_policy: The successor vector is lexicographically minimized by vertex ID. For a vertex, outgoing neighbor IDs are tried ascending; the path-end marker N is tried last.
algorithm_profile.cycle_validation: Kahn topological removal must visit all vertices before the graph is accepted.

complexity.primary_time: O((M+N) * N * M) for bounded repeated Kuhn matching feasibility; N<=10 and M<=45

workspace.meaning: Fixed adjacency masks, Kuhn augmenting-path state, canonicalization scratch, and the ten-nibble successor vector.
